title: Clamp with ifs
prompt: The robot's speed must stay between low and high. Return value, but never below low and never above high, using if statements rather than clamp(). solve(15, 0, 10) is 10.
starter:
func solve(value, low, high):
	return value
hints: Check too low, then too high, then fall through to the value itself.
`if value < low:` return low, `elif value > high:` return high, `else:` return value.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
